title: Book request
description: Sent by a selected book-guided expert to the Librarian before analysis.

request_kind.description: initial: the first request for this assignment. replacement: the expert rejected a book and asks for exactly one more.

expertise.description: The field and judgment this expert contributes to the panel.

question.description: One sentence: the decision or review question for this assignment.

architecture_problem.description: The concrete system, boundary, risk, or design problem the books must help this expert judge.

watch_list.description: Files, components, or artifacts in scope for this expert.

excluded_books.description: Every book this expert has rejected for this assignment, by exact identity. The Librarian must not return any of them. Required for a replacement request.
